name: Render UI
description: Render native components or an OpenIntelligentUI sandbox in chat for tables, charts, diagrams, calculators, and simulations.

function.name: render_ui
function.description: Render or update an interactive UI tree in the chat. Native nodes use declarative JSON; HTML/JS is accepted only inside sandbox nodes. EVERY node needs a string type. Supported types: text, markdown, card, stack, grid, badge, divider, table, chart, mermaid, image, link, input, select, button, sandbox. Root is usually type=stack with a children array. Render naturally in the conversation with transparent backgrounds; avoid card backgrounds, borders, and Interactive badges. Group related controls/results with spacing and typography rather than boxed panels. Example: {type:stack,title:Sales,children:[{type:chart,data:[{label:Jan,value:10}]},{type:button,id:refresh,label:Refresh,action:refresh}]}. Use native table/chart nodes for simple data. For custom interactive explanations, calculators, simulations, SVG, or canvas, use type=sandbox with html, css, jsFunctions, jsExpressions, and initialHeight (integer 120..1200). The sandbox includes OpenIntelligentUI theme/form/SVG styles, Three.js/D3/GSAP/Chart.js imports, and window.createTripAnimator for playable map stops. Supports 3D controls, table-to-chart follow-ups, calculators, and live map/photo layouts. Preserve source values on follow-ups, label illustrative data, validate calculator inputs, and show readable library/WebGL failures. JavaScript runs as classic scripts: put async imports inside async functions. sendPrompt({text}) sends a follow-up with selected values; openLink({url}) opens an HTTPS link. Sandbox controls run locally; they do not read Tomo storage or call Tomo APIs. Use stable ui_id values. mode=replace sends a full tree; mode=patch sends JSON patch ops under /tree or /state. Every input/select/button needs id and action. Use save_artifact when the user needs a downloadable file.

mode.description: replace renders a full tree; patch applies up to 50 JSON operations to the existing ui_id.

tree.description:
Root declarative UI node. Containers use children; table uses columns/rows; chart uses data [{label,value}]. Required for replace. Sandbox: {type:sandbox,html:"
...
",css:"...",jsFunctions:"function update(){...}",jsExpressions:"update();",initialHeight:400}.

patch.description: Patch operations: {op:add|replace|remove,path:/tree/... or /state/...,value:...}. Required when patch mode has no tree.

state.description: Serializable UI state to retain across updates and reloads.
